origin.label: Chihuahua Headquarters
origin.headline: Where it all began.
origin.body: Our first location marked the beginning of a journey built around connectivity, technology, and the trust of our customers.

timeline.headline: A story of continuous evolution.
timeline.body: Each stage reflects Ecosat’s ability to adapt, grow, and integrate new technologies around operational needs.

radio.label: E1 · 1992 · Connect
radio.headline: Where it all began: connecting people, places, and opportunities through communication.
radio.body: Ecosat was built to bring people, places, and opportunities closer through communication, delivering information where it was needed most.
radio.technology: Radio communication, wireless links, and transmission systems to connect locations where communication was limited.

integration.label: E2 · 2003 · Integrate
integration.headline: Connectivity evolved into the foundation that supports operations.
integration.body: Ecosat integrated technology, infrastructure, and systems so organizations can communicate, operate, and grow with confidence.
integration.technology: Telecommunications infrastructure, networks, structured cabling, and technology systems that enable connected operations.

solutions.label: E3 · 2026 · Understand and decide
solutions.headline: Connected worlds. Driven decisions.
solutions.body: Today we bring together people, technology, and data to create operations that are more visible, connected, and prepared for the future.
solutions.technology: Integrated physical systems, intelligent monitoring, sensors, digital platforms, and artificial intelligence to turn data into decisions.

expansion.headline: A growing presence.
expansion.body: Our evolution allows us to support operations across new regions and markets.

presence.label: Ecosat expansion
presence.headline: Where your operation is, Ecosat is there.
presence.body: Our presence connects infrastructure, technology, and teams across different regions of Mexico and North America.

industriesClose: Ecosat is trusted not only for what it can install, but for what it understands, connects, and continues to support.
